decisions.reason: The firm has publicly presented this decorative carpet on its own page and only launched it in 2023, so any weak early results can still be blamed on a temporary market slowdown, which favours persisting.
A hand-knotted wool silk carpet ties up substantial sourcing and inventory investment and signals premium positioning, so sunk costs and the need to justify the choice weigh toward keeping it.
This low-pile decorative carpet is still within its first year and is visibly showcased, so management would likely attribute soft sales to the weak furniture market rather than drop it.
A corner bench involves tooling and production setup costs that management has committed to, and it fits the core furniture business, which encourages persistence.
Low-pile carpets in a broad range are interchangeable, which raises some risk of pruning, but the recent public launch and short time on the market argue for giving it more time.
The swivel shell chair is a seating product central to the furniture line, and design and production investment plus its visible presentation make continuation likely.
